title: Ammonia decomposition reference family
objective: Optional literature-backed reference family for sanity-checking catalyst economics against a specific reaction window. COMET itself remains reaction-agnostic and uses these routes as starting points, not as the product boundary.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance economics, source confidence, route confidence, and performance.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward selling cost while keeping route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward transparent, higher-confidence pricing and more reproducible routes.

route_templates.name: Wet impregnation on oxide support
synthesis: Slurry mixing or incipient wetness loading
route_templates.route_note: Most transferable route for industrial catalyst screening and the easiest baseline to scale.

route_templates.name: Interface-engineered Ni-MgO-CeO2 route
route_templates.route_note: Improves performance without noble metal loading, but route discipline and support engineering are less mature.

route_templates.name: Ru dispersion on basic oxide
synthesis: Low-volume deposition with tight Ru balance
route_templates.route_note: Premium low-temperature route with the clearest activity upside but the highest sensitivity to Ru pricing.

candidates.title: Ni/gamma-Al2O3 baseline
candidates.summary: Non-noble industrial baseline for current-price screening.
decision_notes: Tracks Ni live price directly, so economics move with a broadly traded industrial metal.
Lowest route complexity and easiest basis to defend in desktop screening.

pricing.note: Live Ni feed with nitrate-style precursor markup.

Industrial support screening proxy retained to avoid lab-pack alumina distortion. USGS MCS 2026 metallurgical alumina (2025e $590/t import value, ~$0.27/lb) is the public floor; catalyst-grade premium retained. UN Comtrade 2024: calcined alumina (HS 281820) averaged $0.60/kg with specialty flows to $3.64/kg; catalyst-carrier activated/gamma alumina marketplace offers run $800-1,700/t.

candidates.title: Ni-MgO/CeO2 interface
candidates.summary: Ni route that aims to recover activity through support/interface engineering instead of noble metal loading.
decision_notes: Still avoids Ru, but the route adds ceria handling and tighter support engineering.
Useful when you want better low-temperature activity without moving to a noble-metal basis.

pricing.note: Live Ni feed with precursor markup.
2025 USGS cerium-oxide price used as a bulk support/promoter proxy.

MgO support uses a screening proxy rather than reagent-pack pricing. UN Comtrade 2024 magnesia imports (HS 251990) averaged $0.52/kg (China $0.39/kg; high-purity flows to $4.10/kg), bracketing this proxy from below; Sigma 342793 lab price ($0.38/g) is the packaged ceiling.

candidates.title: Ru/MgO premium
candidates.summary: High-activity Ru route for low-temperature ammonia cracking when activity is worth a noble-metal premium.
decision_notes: Performance leader at low temperature, but economics are dominated by Ru exposure.
Best fit when reactor temperature or start-up intensity matters more than catalyst replacement cost.

pricing.note: Ru feed tracked on the live/reference metal board with precursor markup.

Support cost kept on an engineering basis even though a public Sigma quote is attached for transparency. UN Comtrade 2024 magnesia imports (HS 251990) averaged $0.52/kg (China $0.39/kg; high-purity flows to $4.10/kg), bracketing this proxy from below; Sigma 342793 lab price ($0.38/g) is the packaged ceiling.

candidates.title: Co/MgO-La2O3 mid-cost route
candidates.summary: 5 wt% cobalt on a lanthana-promoted magnesia support reaches 92% ammonia conversion at 550 C, sitting between the nickel workhorse and the ruthenium premium on both cost and activity.
decision_notes: Pick it when Ru economics fail but the Ni baseline's higher light-off temperature is unacceptable.
Preparation-route sensitivity is the documented risk: precipitation shrinks Co particles but risks inactive spinel formation.

pricing.note: Live Co feed with a mild precursor conversion markup; 5 wt% loading is source-quoted.

Basic support term held on a conservative engineering proxy. UN Comtrade 2024 magnesia imports (HS 251990) averaged $0.52/kg (China $0.39/kg; high-purity flows to $4.10/kg), bracketing this proxy from below; Sigma 342793 lab price ($0.38/g) is the packaged ceiling.
2025 lanthanum oxide 99.5% price of $1.00/kg (Argus via USGS MCS 2026 rare-earths chapter).
